title: Avoiding Secondhand Smoke
subtitle: Prevention, risk factors, screening, evidence, and practical actions related to avoiding secondhand smoke.
related_modules: DIS-158: Tobacco Use Prevention and Cessation
DIS-160: Respiratory Health and Air Pollution
DIS-165: Maternal and Child Health Risks from Smoking
evidence_strength: Established evidence from multiple high-quality epidemiological studies and systematic reviews supports the health risks of secondhand smoke and effectiveness of smoke-free policies. Emerging evidence is evaluating the health impact of low-level outdoor and novel nicotine products exposure. Some limitations exist in long-term tracking of partial exposure and compliance with smoke-free laws.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
